hard_rules: Assessment Plan scope/evidence alignment is mandatory.

Canonical AP Calculus Bank instructional items and Unit Summatives are constructed/open response under the current Universal Bank PM; Blooket is the selected-response exception. Source MC examples may inform misconceptions/task structure but are not instantiated as Bank MC.
Official AP theorem/definition conditions and notation follow the supplied CED.
AP Topics are structural/scoring models, not text to clone.
Practice family allocation is planned from the full-scope map. Purposeful repeated families are allowed; avoid whole-form personalities and stock reasoning suffixes.
Contextual answers preserve units and variable meaning.
Calculator-supported FRQ-style work includes the mathematical setup when the supplied CED requires it.
Figures/graphs/tables are answer-neutral when students must infer the feature.
Student-facing tables are rendered as real tables/data displays, not raw serialized arrays.
Formative-secure/secure items are semantically independent from exposed instructional items.
Repeated Practice families/numeric variants are legitimate; do not add second-pass/another-version labels or a form-wide generic reasoning/checking suffix.

The authoring chat runs concise pre-delivery content/structure QA. Final-byte mutation/audit is owned by the included local ~finalize_bank.py after download; do not add a competing postprocessor sequence.
ap_specific_review: FRQ scoring evidence separated into meaningful components
practice_scaffold_review: Distinctive non-routine scaffold reuse across unrelated families is a quality warning; Student A/B or supplied-conclusion tasks may be used where natural but cannot become the generator default.

map_first_repetition.late_audit_distinction: Pre-authoring map review is not a late anti-clone/diversification pass.
